name: Hello World
description: A sample plugin that showcases the SDK capabilities. Use this plugin as a starting point for your own.
author: Kiosk Satellite contributors

settings.title: Greeting
settings.default: Hello from a Kiosk Satellite plugin!
settings.description: Text input: the message in the floating window.

settings.title: Show window when enabled
settings.description: Toggle: open the floating window when the plugin starts.

settings.title: Show demo chart
settings.description: Display simulated data in the plugin subpage.

settings.title: Chart type
settings.description: Display samples as lines or grouped bars.

settings.title: Chart size
settings.description: Use a full chart with axes or a compact mini chart.

settings.title: Amplitude
settings.description: Slider: adjust the height of new simulated samples.

settings.title: Pattern
settings.description: Selection: choose the shape of new simulated samples.

settings.title: Series color
settings.description: Color picker: set the Wave series color.

settings.title: Enable Shizuku demo
settings.description: Read a device diagnostic through Shizuku every 10 seconds. Results appear in Readings.

settings.title: Diagnostic
settings.description: Choose the read-only command to run after granting Shizuku access.

settings.title: Logo size
settings.description: Resize the bouncing DVD logo. 100% uses the original size.

settings.title: Logo color
settings.description: DVD logo color. Select DVD Logo (Hello World) in Screensaver mode to use this demo.

settings.title: Background color
settings.description: Background behind the bouncing logo. Uses all stock screensaver settings.

settings.title: Home Assistant entity
settings.description: Choose an entity to show its state and follow changes through Kiosk Satellite.
